## Scope

Describe the affected scientific and software contracts.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Public test level passes.
- [ ] Format, structure, documentation, and release gates pass.
- [ ] Numerical changes report max-abs, max-rel, relative-L2, and NaN/Inf counts.
- [ ] Schema, restart, parallel determinism, and performance reachability were reviewed.

## Data and licensing

- [ ] No credentials, private paths, proprietary inputs, pseudopotentials, or generated outputs are included.
- [ ] New data or dependencies have explicit provenance and redistribution terms.
